description: Isobutylphenyl propionic acid (NSAID): strong primary π→π* absorption at 222 nm (ε ~15300) from the phenyl chromophore, with fine benzenoid B-band structure at 264 nm (ε ~370) and a vibronic fine-structure shoulder at 272 nm (ε ~290) in methanol. The 264 nm band is used for pharmaceutical UV assay.
transition: π → π* aromatic benzenoid transition (E₂ band at 264/272 nm; strong π-π* at 222 nm)
clinicalNote: Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID). Pharmacopoeial UV-Vis assay in methanol at 264 nm (E₂ benzenoid band). The 222 nm high-energy band is used for high-sensitivity determination.

sources.citation: British Pharmacopoeia 2023, Ibuprofen Monograph. UV assay in methanol: ε 15300 at 222 nm; benzenoid fine structure at 264/272 nm.
sources.purpose: λmax 222 nm, ε 15300 (high-energy band); 264 nm assay wavelength
UV-Vis spectrum parameters in methanol confirming benzenoid fine structure
